What every entry has

  • A level: Beginner, Intermediate or Developer.
  • A cost label, such as Free, Open source, Freemium or Paid.
  • A one-line description in our own words, written for this guide.
  • A link tested on October 29, 2026.

For 79 paid tools it also shows plan names and prices, read from the vendor’s pricing page on that date. Three of the 79 come from price trackers, and they are marked.

Why you can trust the links

AI tools change names, owners and addresses often. Testing every link on October 29, 2026 turned up 30 notable changes, and the guide logs each one. Windsurf is now Devin Desktop. Play.ht has closed. Everything AI 2026 is a snapshot as of that date.

What it is not

It is not every AI tool. An entry goes in only if it is about AI, its link works, it has shipped or posted in the last 12 months, its job can be stated in one line, and its pricing is public or it has a free tier. No vendor paid to be listed or to get a Pick, and no link carries an affiliate code.

Prices change, so confirm on the vendor’s site before you pay.
